entries.summary: A deliberately bounded executable subset covers root and embedded subprocess scopes, none start/end events, generic tasks, normal/conditional/default sequence flows, exclusive routing, parallel split/join epochs, Standard Loops, FixedMultiInstance/1, and CollectionMultiInstance/1 on generic Tasks. Both Multi-Instance profiles freeze one bounded closed member set, record stable index identity and exact counters, run sequentially or in parallel, fence late completion, and causally replay failure cleanup. The collection profile additionally freezes source order and duplicates, makes item mapping explicit, and gathers only complete codec-validated outputs in source-index order. SubProcess or CallActivity multi-instance execution, progressive behavior events, partial output, and open or draining groups remain unsupported.

entries.summary: FixedMultiInstance/1 executes a bounded cardinality-based generic Task profile. It evaluates loopCardinality exactly once at activation, freezes stable item:index identities, supports sequential and parallel scheduling, records exact active/completed/terminated counters over generated instances, and routes once after an all join or the first true completionCondition. That condition terminates already generated active members while a sequential planned suffix is durably marked not-generated and is not included in runtime instance counters; stale completeTask commands are fenced and idempotent. Boundary Error and terminal business-failure paths cancel the generated group before routing or failing, and the journal replays every transition exactly. XML v5 represents broader collection and behavior metadata, but collection execution belongs to the separately evidenced CollectionMultiInstance/1 profile and behavior remains All.

entries.summary: CollectionMultiInstance/1 executes a bounded collection-driven generic Task profile without treating the source as a mutable queue. One exact externally compiled binding for loopDataInputRef is evaluated once at activation and its canonical JSON array is frozen with source indices, order, and duplicates intact. A scalar inputDataItem explicitly opts into current-item mapping. Complete output gathering requires loopDataOutputRef, a scalar outputDataItem, a matching collection-valued Task DataOutput, and a protocol-v3 Task binding; codec-validated outputs are gathered by source index, and empty input yields an empty output array. Output gathering with completionCondition is rejected until a partial-result policy exists. Data, evaluator, collection, and Task bindings plus all collection/item/output limits are fingerprinted. Parallel all-join mode supplies bounded WCP14 evidence. The pure kernel does not require Effect Workflow; its native bridge is optional and separately tested. Progressive behavior, SubProcess/CallActivity Multi-Instance, streaming manifests, open WCP15 creation, WCP34/WCP36, and complete Process Execution Conformance are not claimed.

entries.summary: A fingerprinted protocol-v3 binding admits exact durable Task success or business-failure outcomes. A native Effect Workflow bridge checks that binding before dispatch and translates one raw managed-retry result into a portable resolution command without rerunning the handler. Only a compiled exact failure-identity mapping promotes a failure to a BPMN Error; one matching interrupting Boundary Error catches it, while unmapped or uncaught failures deterministically fail the root execution. Operational timeout, defects, and interruption remain outside Error routing. Resolution idempotency and causal journal replay are enforced. The complete Activity lifecycle and wider event catalogue remain unsupported.

entries.summary: Named profile bpmn-2.0.2-core-process-di-v5 performs fail-closed namespace-expanded import, validation, canonical-prefix export, and normalized round-trip for its explicitly bounded process/control-flow slice, including Standard Loop and represented Multi-Instance characteristics on generic Tasks. Multi-Instance cardinality, collection references, scalar inputDataItem/outputDataItem declarations with namespace-expanded itemSubjectRef QNames and xsd:string names including the empty string, mode, completionCondition, behavior, and One/None event references round-trip in BPMN XSD order. Data-item IDs are globally checked, absent isCollection materializes false, and unrepresented child content fails closed; complex behavior definitions remain outside the slice. Executable collection semantics additionally require exact fingerprinted external bindings. Modeled records implementation maturity because normative XSD validation, complete semantic mapping, and an OMG conformance subclass are not claimed.

entries.summary: FixedMultiInstance/1 evaluates a runtime cardinality exactly once before member creation. CollectionMultiInstance/1 instead snapshots one bounded array with stable source indices, order, and duplicates. Parallel all-join mode supplies the WCP14 concurrent form: the closed member set is known before expansion, members may complete in any order without changing identity or ordered durable state, and no later source mutation can add a member. Sequential mode is an additional BPMN execution form, not evidence for WCP14's concurrent reading. Open WCP15 creation is not claimed.

entries.summary: The admitted WCP35 evidence is the parallel closed-group subset. It evaluates one pinned completionCondition after each committed member completion; the first true result records exact counters, terminates every already generated active remainder, emits one continuation, and fences late completeTask commands. A sequential planned suffix is not counted as generated or terminated and supplies no concurrent-cancellation evidence. CollectionMultiInstance/1 admits the same condition only without output gathering. WCP15 open creation and WCP34/WCP36 draining behavior are not claimed and require OpenForEachGroup/1.
